comment: Fixed ESLint config for the quality reading Q (SPEC § 5). Frozen before round 1. The 'comment' key is dropped before linting. ES built-ins come from ecmaVersion; browser globals come from the pinned `globals` package's browser set (merged in friday/adapters/eslint_count.mjs, under the list here); 'event' is the handler attribute's event. Module scripts are linted with sourceType 'module'. Inline eslint comments are ignored, so artifact code cannot switch a rule off.
